# Phase-B flat-wet / flat-dry exemplar set — ground-truth contrast for B3

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m dataset.exemplars`. Do not hand-edit numbers; re-run to refresh. The per-exemplar CSV is the artifact; this is its cover sheet. -->

Resolves issue #25 (part of the Phase-B map, #23). A hand-picked set of **4 flat-wet** and **4 flat-dry** locations, each resolved to a specific production window and scored through the **same B1 frame** the pilot uses (:mod:`dataset.pilot`): every metric at its Gate A3 resolution (#21) plus the three EDM/FLM/WBM mask fractions. B3 asks whether the surviving metrics *separate* wet from dry; this is the labelled contrast set that question needs — windows the algorithm did **not** choose for itself.

- Exemplars: **8** scored. Each is the production grid window nearest a point interior to the named feature.
- Data: the per-exemplar scores are committed alongside this sheet in [`exemplars-per-window.csv`](exemplars-per-window.csv) — the artifact B3 reads; this sheet is its cover.
- Provenance: code `3da4c59-dirty`, snapshot `2026-07-20`, overview ×8.
